name: CN_PLAN_COMPONENTS_ALL_B
description: Contains detail data about the Plan Components.

columns.name: PLAN_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Plan Component id is the number generated by the system

columns.name: CALC_VARIABLE_ID
columns.description: Id used for package generation.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: INCREMENTAL_TYPE
columns.description: This column is to store incremental type

columns.name: INCENTIVE_TYPE
columns.description:
Determines the type of plan component - 
(1) per event (commission) 
(2) per interval (bonus)

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the plan component

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This is the End date of plan component

columns.name: EARNING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Determines the earning type of the plan component

columns.name: PLAN_COMP_STATUS
columns.description: This column determines whether plan component is valid for calculation

columns.name: AP_LIAB_ID
columns.description: This column is to store related Liability Account ID

columns.name: AP_EXP_ID
columns.description: This column is to store related Expense Accout ID

columns.name: REPORT_GROUP
columns.description: Stores the incentive type for plan component

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates whether the plan component is active

columns.name: PAYMENT_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: This column is to store payment group for this plan component

columns.name: CALCULATION_PHASE
columns.description: Determines the phase in which calculation engine processes this plan component

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: This column is to store the currency code

columns.name: INDIRECT_CREDIT
columns.description: This column is to store indirect credit

columns.name: THIRDPARTY_PAYEE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether third party payment is allowed

columns.name: SALESREP_ENDDATED_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates if calculation needs to be done on this plan components even for the end dated participants

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS
columns.description: Approval Status of the plan component

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
